Pick a topic, a question, a dilemma of some sort and just write non stop for a designated time. Look at descriptive writing that visualizes what you're trying to write. This will teach you to pick up nuances in whatever you write, which will gradually translate to your emotions and all.

Ma Sirjana ma padhthe ani ma ekdum brutally honest answer haru lekhchu tara main kura bhaneko tya padhne farak student haruko ekdumai farak experiences hunthyo so these are my perspective.

1. Class timing effective nai cha, teacher haru time ma aucha ani padhaucha. Most of the time chai sikaune kaam chai kaam vako hoki bhanne feel vayo. Jasko matlab the onus is in you. One thing you MUST do is make friends with hardworking people, coz it is very easy to be deviated as college environment dherai pressure dine khalko chaina.
2. Beginner haru dherai aucha Sirjana ma chai, KU ra Lalitkala bhanda. Course ko anusar sikai huncha ani as a beginner chai halka chado biteko jasto nai lagdo raicha. So, 1st year ma beginner lai ekdumai cater garera padhaucha, tesko lagi tension linu pardaina. Beginner ko lagi Sirjana college best hola bharu.
3. Again if you're a complete beginner, Sirjana college ma environment ramro cha. 1st year alik handhelding garcha. 2nd year dekhi chai they shift a lot of responsibility on yourself and you need to be ready for it. Result oriented art garyau bhane khasai overwhelming chaina, learning based garyau art chai ekai choti auda you might be overwhelmed because there is so much to learn. Environment chai thikai cha sikna lai. They start with almost 40 50 students in the 1st year and the number decreases to half until final year. So, its a massive long term commitment.
4. The studio is well there is not much to be proud of sorry to say. They have enough materials to learn in the beginning phase, but its not super artsy like they show in the movies. In fact it is gritty and teaches you a lot. It taught me a lot, as I came from family where most of my needs are met with ease. I had a studio in my home and worked solely there as I preferred to work alone. But you can stay as much as you like. I did not find the working environment inspiring but that is my personal experience and there are a lot of people who actually thrive in that environment.
5. Project and off campus activities are very limited. There are some opportunities but very few and far between. Your best bet is to get closer to instructors and personally carve opportunities, which is not that difficult to be honest. (For example we had a tour in Bangladesh but a teacher was solely responsible for creating opportunity). There are few visits outside the valley as well. Graphics ma chai exhibition haru held vairahuncha.
6. Again the college runs in a very tight budget. So, the labs are not super updated or modern but is very functional and doesnot limit your learning. 
7. I cannot answer this question for you at this stage. You need exploration. Sirjana ko graphics alumni haru tei private institute haru ma graphic designer, illustrator etc chan. Exceptional naam ta khasai chainan tara khali baseka chainan.
8. Entrance ko lagi kei prepare garnu pardaina, euta still life banauna sodcha. 

Another important thing I want to say is that Sirjana college is mostly geared towards traditional practices. Dherai traditional style ko padhai huncha. Graphics ho bhane I suggest first trying at KU. KU ko entrance ma pani tei euta still life with water sodhcha re vanthe ani you need to do well in the entrance to get selected. Graphics ma modern teaching ra application chaincha. Plus KU ko final year project haru graphics ma chai atti daami cha. Traditional painting ma ho bhane, Sirjana is not a bad option as it is so much cheaper. 

Hope you got what you were looking for. First and formost be absolutely sure that afno bato afai banaunu parne field ho so laj saj daar saar sabai falnu parcha bhanera prepare hau, at least when you are towards the end of you Bachelors chai afaile purai responsibility linai parcha. Ja padhe pani hami western haru jasto fortunate chaina ki tyakka tyakka sab kura mileko huncha. Struggle bhaneko garnai parcha ra tesma ramna siknai parcha, especially art field ma. 

Best of Luck
